senses.gloss: m. (חָשַׁל; Syr. מחשולא, P. Sm. 1404) a crushing wind (cmp.
units: I Kings XIX, 11) ; esp. (שבים) נ׳ gale on high sea, also Naḥshol, a spirit.
<cite ref="Tosefta Yoma 2:4">Tosef. Yoma II, 4</cite>; <cite ref="Yoma 38a:2">Yoma 38ᵃ</cite> (Y. ib. III, 41ᵃ <he>סער גדול</he>).

<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 7:14">Tosef. B. Mets. VII, 14</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 116b:7">B. Kam. 116ᵇ</cite>; Y. B. Mets. VI, end, 11ᵃ <he>ספינה שעמד עליה נ׳ והיקל וכ׳</he> if a gale threatened the ship, and they lighted it.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 32:1">Pesik. R. s. 32</cite> <he>אחזו נחשולה</he> (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 13:7">Num. R. s. 13</cite> (play on <cite ref="N00527"><he>נחשון</he></cite>) <he>על שם שירד תחלה לנ׳ שבים</he> because he was the first to go down to the surf (or to Naḥshol) in the sea.
Gitt. 56ᵇ עמד עליו נ׳ שבים וכ׳ a naḥshol in the sea stood up against him to drown him; Yalk. Koh. 972 נ׳ של ים.
